description: Rate one run or one catalog request of this workspace good or bad, with an optional note on what was right or wrong (missing rows, wrong data, too slow). Ahel reads every rating to fix providers and the catalog. Free; changes nothing else. NOT for: reading a run's state or rows, which is capability_run_status.

id.description: An execution id from run_capability, or a request id from catalog_request.

note.description: Optional: what was right or wrong, in a sentence or two.

name: feedback
title: Rate a run or request
